title: Linux_Remaiten_Botnet_Investigation_dcc
description: Investigate and identify malicious activity, determine its scope, and recommend containment measures for the Linux/Remaiten botnet.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential unauthorized access. Your task is to investigate and identify any malicious activity related to the Linux/Remaiten botnet, determine its scope, and recommend containment measures.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials:
- Username: cyrano
- Password: cyrano

Enter the word 'start' to progress to the next level.
levels.local_content: Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content:
Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication.

**Question:** What is the name of the suspicious service that communicates with an external host?
levels.solution: To identify the suspicious service, run the command `systemctl list-units --type=service` and look for `bot-beacon.service` (service name).

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services using the command `systemctl list-units --type=service` and look for unusual network connections.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services that are not part of the standard system configuration. Use the command `systemctl list-units --type=service` to list all services and identify `bot-beacon.service`.

levels.title: Identify Flood Service
levels.content:
Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic.

**Question:** What is the name of the service generating excessive network traffic?
levels.solution: To identify the service generating excessive network traffic, run the command `ss -tulnp` and look for `bot-flood.service` (service name).

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate systemd services and check for unusual network activity using the command `ss -tulnp`.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check for services that are consuming unusual amounts of network resources. Use the command `ss -tulnp` to list all network connections and identify `bot-flood.service`.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content:
Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.

**Question:** What is the persistence mechanism used by the suspicious service?
levels.solution: To determine the persistence mechanism, run the command `systemctl list-timers` and look for `bot-beacon.timer` and `bot-flood.timer` (systemd timers).

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine systemd timers and services for clues about automatic execution using the command `systemctl list-timers`.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Examine systemd timers for clues about automatic execution. Use the command `systemctl list-timers` to list all timers and identify `bot-beacon.timer` and `bot-flood.timer`.
